Official links & verification

Everything that is officially FLOP is on this page: the accounts, the domains, the one public email address. Anything else — any link, handle, domain, email or contract address claiming to be FLOP — is not official. There is no FLOP token yet. Nothing is trading, and there is no mint, claim, presale or airdrop live. If you can buy it, trade it, mint it or claim it, it is not FLOP.

The docs chatbot at ask.flop.finance answers questions about official links, accounts, contracts, the token and the airdrop from this page. A contract address or account that is not listed here is not official, whatever it claims.

Owner: FLOP Labs. Updated 2026-10-23. The page is reviewed with every announcement that touches links, the token, a contract, the testnet or the airdrop, and whenever a new impersonator is confirmed.

Official accounts and surfaces

  • X, the primary channel and where airdrop eligibility is announced: x.com/flop_labs
  • YouTube: youtube.com/@flop_labs
  • TikTok: tiktok.com/@flop_labs
  • GitHub: github.com/flop-labs
  • Website: flop.finance — the project intro, whitepaper, testnet, airdrop, teaser and Yellow Paper pages all live under it
  • Docs chatbot and this knowledge corpus: ask.flop.finance
  • Operator docs: docs.flop.network
  • Technical domain: flop.network — the public API gateway at api.flop.network, the hosted read-only MCP at mcp.flop.network, the devnet faucet at faucet.flop.network and the devnet RPC at rpc.devnet.flop.network
  • Security contact: security@flop.finance — the only official email address, and the place to report an impersonation

There is no official FLOP Discord, Telegram, Reddit or Medium, so an invitation to a FLOP server, channel or subreddit never comes from FLOP. FLOP publishes no other social account: a profile using the FLOP name that is not listed above is unverified and may be an impersonation.

There is no FLOP token yet

There is nowhere you can buy FLOP: the token does not exist, nothing is trading, there is no mint, no claim, no presale and no airdrop live, and there is nothing to buy. If you see a FLOP token trading anywhere, or a site offering a mint or a claim, it is a scam — the token does not exist yet. Mainnet and TGE are targeted for Q1 2027. Until then no FLOP contract address exists, because there is no token to issue one.

Where a real contract or claim will be announced

When a real FLOP token contract exists, its address will be published on this page and from @flop_labs on X, and nowhere else. Until an address appears on this page, any contract, mint, claim, presale, airdrop or listing presented as FLOP is not FLOP's — no matter which account, website or direct message it comes from. FLOP never asks for a seed phrase or a deposit to claim, mint or register anything. This page does not name impersonators: a link, handle or contract that is not listed here is not FLOP, and that rule is what protects you. To report one, email security@flop.finance.

Current testnet and airdrop status

From the published docs, which carry the target and draft wording:

  • Devnet is running and earns nothing: no rewards and no airdrop weight.
  • Testnet launch: the working target is Tuesday 3 November 2026, running about 90 days. A target, not a fixed date.
  • Mainnet and TGE: Q1 2027, tracking to early February.
  • The genesis pool is 4.4bn FLOP in the draft airdrop page — including a 1.2bn agent cohort — and every figure in it is provisional. The genesis distribution ceremony is not yet wired.

See the testnet and timeline FAQ and the airdrop and testnet conversion for the full detail.
